title: Demo damaged-product handling policy
content: A consumer claim and image observation support investigation. Eligibility still requires an order match and service-policy review.

title: Demo beauty-service safety boundary
content: Visible redness or swelling must not be converted into diagnosis or product causality. Medical attention and severe reports require human-reviewed service escalation.

title: Demo cream ingredient list
content: Demo Cream ingredients: water, glycerin, niacinamide, fragrance.
